dedupe_keys.name: ribuild hotbox coldbox experiment with solid wall in combination with wooden beam ends at ku leuven

description: Stijn Roels of KU Leuven publishes measurements from a hotbox/coldbox experiment on a solid wall with an embedded wooden beam end. The study examines how an air gap between the finishing and beam end interacts with different internal-insulation systems. The dataset also contains photographs of construction and sensor installation. Zenodo lists twelve text, spreadsheet and image files, available freely under CC BY 4.0. This controlled envelope experiment supports assessment of coupled thermal and moisture behaviour relevant to building-insulation simulations. A limitation is that the description does not enumerate the measurement variables, dates, sampling intervals or boundary-condition values. The source names separate related experiments at TU Dresden and at the DTU outdoor test stand; these site and exposure differences distinguish the described experimental setups. The existing RIBuild historic-building survey gives broader renovation context. No measurement files were opened or model comparison reproduced.
